title_uk: Ukrainian officials stole $100 million of Western military aid

origin.origin_note_en: First observed on a Pravda-network node, then republished across mirrors in four languages within 48 hours.

label: $100m military aid stolen

debunk_argument.assertion: The $100 million came from Western military aid.
debunk_argument.refutation: It came from contractors paying kickbacks on domestic procurement contracts. No aid instrument financed those contracts.

debunk_argument.assertion: The investigation confirmed the aid link.
debunk_argument.refutation: The published materials name the contracts, the suspects and the mechanism. They do not mention aid.

false_claim: Ukrainian officials stole $100 million of Western military aid
canonical_debunk: The corruption case is real, was opened by Ukrainian anti-corruption bodies and remains under prosecution. The link to Western aid appears nowhere in the case file: the money came from contracts funded out of Ukraine's own budget.
